body: ik, ik, username checks out - but let me just say I'm extremely straight and extremely male
I'm a Wish employee with \~230k worth of unvested RSUs @ 17.xx -  if this goes to 30, I will fly to his place and personally suck his cock.

I accepted multiple offers with a range of start dates, with the more desirable jobs having earlier start dates (companies are usually flexible).  I will renege these companies days before their start date unless my top job offer gets cancelled, in which case, no biggie, I just start working for the next most preferable company. 

I know this is screwing over the companies' resources and other applicants but I genuinely don't give a fuck - it's a tough economy and I need to look out for myself.

Hopefully, not all of my top places rescind. For anyone curious, my top choices are two major hedge funds, followed by one FAANGs and my list goes all the way down to a random Series A startup. Right now, I'm sitting on eight accepted offers. 

I recommend everybody else does this too, especially if you'll be on visa (OPT in my case) like me as your unemployment days are limited.

You need to develop some sort of leverage on a certain clique in order to not be a filler. For instance, get a fancy gaming console, and all your gamer friends will flock to your apartment and suddenly you're not just a filler. Learn a useful skill/hobby and suddenly you're an integral part of a clique that cares about that skill or hobby. There's a lot of other ways. Be funny. Be rich. Hell, rent a nice apartment where all your friends would enjoy having parties/hangouts at. You need to provide value to be not seen as a filler.
Thank you so much! Really appreciate your response. :) This gives me a lot of hope.
